function.name: read
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file (at most 1 MiB) with line numbers. Returned output is bounded.

path.description: File path inside the workspace; parent directory must exist.

max_output.description: Maximum Unicode code points in output.

function.name: write
function.description: Create or overwrite a UTF-8 file. Parent must exist. Content at most 1 MiB.

path.description: File path inside the workspace; parent directory must exist.

content.description: Complete new file content; empty is allowed.

function.name: edit
function.description: Replace old_text exactly once. Reject missing or ambiguous matches, including overlaps. Read first.

path.description: File path inside the workspace; parent directory must exist.

old_text.description: Nonempty exact text that occurs only once.

new_text.description: Replacement text; empty deletes the match.

function.name: bash
function.description: Run a bash command in the workspace with no interactive stdin. Returns combined stdout/stderr, exit code, timeout and truncation flags. This is not a sandbox.
